summaries.en: As the second US-Iran peace talks collapsed and Iran's Revolutionary Guard attacked three ships near the Hormuz Strait, the conflict between the two nations over control of the strategic waterway is escalating.
summaries.zh: 随着美伊第二次停战谈判破裂，伊朗革命卫队在霍尔木兹海峡附近袭击了三艘船只，两国对这一战略水道控制权的冲突正在加剧。
